Title: Create a new order with all required fields and valid values
Preconditions: A valid shop ID exists in the system, and at least one item is available for order

Title: Update an existing order with all required fields and valid values
Preconditions: An existing order with ID 1-20240515-0001 is present in the system

Title: Attempt to create an order with missing required fields and verify validation errors
Section: Order Management - Input Validation for Order Creation
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /api/orders with the payload in testData. 2. Verify the response status and error messages.

Test Data: {
  "shopId": null,
  "customerName": "",
  "customerPhone": "123",
  "customerGender": null,
  "paidAmount": -100.00,
  "deliveryDate": "",
  "items": []
}

Title: Create an order with missing required fields in measurement groups and verify validation errors
Section: Order Management - Input Validation for Measurement Groups
Preconditions: A valid shop ID exists in the system, and at least one item is available for order

Title: Create a new order without specifying a trial date and verify it is handled correctly
Section: Order Management - Optional Trial Date Handling
Preconditions: A valid shop ID exists in the system, and at least one item is available for order

Title: Attempt to create an order with an invalid customer phone number format
Expected Result: The system rejects the request with HTTP 400 Bad Request. The response body contains status 'error', message 'Validation failed', and field error 'customerPhone': 'Invalid phone number format'.

Title: Attempt to create an order with a negative paid amount
Expected Result: The system rejects the request with HTTP 400 Bad Request. The response body contains status 'error', message 'Validation failed', and field error 'paidAmount': 'Paid amount cannot be negative'.

Title: Attempt to record a payment for an order with a null paid amount during order creation
Expected Result: The system rejects the request with HTTP 400 Bad Request. The response body contains status 'error', message 'Validation failed', and field error 'paidAmount': 'Paid amount is required'. The order is not created.

Title: Attempt to update an order with a negative item making charge
Preconditions: An existing order with ID 100 exists in the system.
Expected Result: The system rejects the order update with HTTP 400 Bad Request. The response body contains field error 'items[0].measurementGroups[0].makingCharge': 'Making charge must be >= 0'.

Title: Attempt to create an order item measurement group with an empty measurements list
Expected Result: The system rejects the request with HTTP 400 Bad Request. The response body contains field error 'items[0].measurementGroups[0].measurements': 'At least one measurement is required'.

Title: Create an order with zero paid amount and zero making charge at the minimum inclusive decimal boundary
Preconditions: A valid shop with ID 1 exists in the system.
Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK status with response body containing status "success", totalAmount 0.0, paidAmount 0.0, and dueAmount 0.0.

Title: Create an order with an empty string for trialDate boundary
Preconditions: A valid shop with ID 1 exists in the system.
Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK status code with response body containing status "success", order summary created, and trialDate set to null without causing a date parsing error.
